title: Senior Java Platform Engineer — Senior Vice President
description_html: Citi is looking for a Senior Java Platform Engineer to lead the engineering of a global check payment platform at the heart of the Payments Platform and Cheque Processing Transformation Initiative. This is a senior role that blends deep, hands-on Java engineering with platform strategy ownership you will write and review production code, shape the architecture of distributed payment systems, and guide a scrum team to deliver mission-critical capabilities across the full payment lifecycle. Your work will directly influence the reliability, scalability, and modernisation of a platform that processes high-volume financial transactions globally.      Responsibilities    Design and build production-grade Java microservices for a high-volume, low-latency global check payment platform, including hands-on coding, architecture reviews, and code reviews that set the technical standard for the team.  Architect event-driven, fault-tolerant distributed systems using Kafka, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIs, covering message schema design, topic partitioning, consumer group strategies, and exactly-once processing.  Define and govern data architecture across Oracle, Microsoft SQL, and MongoDB, driving schema design, indexing strategies, query optimisation, and data consistency across transactional and settlement workflows.  Own the engineering roadmap for modernising the check payment platform, migrating mainframe and monolithic legacy components into reusable, cloud-native microservices aligned to Citi Engineering Excellence Standards.  Lead platform performance engineering by profiling JVM-based applications, identifying and resolving bottlenecks, and optimising critical settlement processing paths to meet SLA commitments on availability, throughput, and latency.  Embed AI-powered engineering practices across the team by leveraging tools such as GitHub Copilot and LLMs (including Gemini) to improve code quality, automate test generation, and accelerate vulnerability identification and remediation.  Act as the primary engineering point of contact for the Check Processing pillar, communicating platform health, delivery progress, and engineering strategy clearly to senior business, technology, and operations stakeholders.  Own the platform's security and compliance posture by leading threat modelling, vulnerability assessments, and secure design reviews to ensure the platform meets regulatory and risk requirements.       Required qualifications & skills    10 or more years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in a people management or senior engineering leadership capacity.  Extensive hands-on Java engineering experience in high-throughput, production environments, including JVM performance tuning, GC optimisation, thread management, and memory profiling.  Hands-on design of microservices architectures using Spring Boot or Spring MVC, covering service decomposition, RESTful API design, inter-service communication, and cloud-native deployment.  Deep practical expertise in Kafka, including topic design, partitioning strategies, consumer group management, and high-throughput stream processing with exactly-once semantics.  Hands-on database engineering across Oracle and Microsoft SQL (schema design, query optimisation, indexing) and MongoDB (document modelling, aggregation pipelines, sharding, replica sets).  Hands-on experience with cloud-native infrastructure including OpenShift, AWS, Kubernetes, and Docker, covering container orchestration, autoscaling, and CI/CD pipeline design using tools such as Jenkins, Gradle, and Maven.  Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.       Beneficial skills & qualifications    Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain or AutoGen, RAG patterns, or vector databases such as Pinecone or Weaviate, applied in an enterprise or regulated context.  Hands-on Python experience in data pipelines, AI/ML integration, scripting, or automation within a financial services or high-throughput engineering environment.  Experience leading large-scale legacy modernisation programmes, including migration of mainframe components written in COBOL, Assembler, or C++ into cloud-native microservices.  Knowledge of MLOps practices including model versioning, deployment pipelines, and production model monitoring, alongside real-time ML model serving techniques.  Experience with chaos engineering, resilience testing, or fault injection, and familiarity with reconciliation and exception handling patterns in settlement workflows.       Education    Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience     What we offer      Joining Citi means taking ownership of a platform that sits at the centre of global payments infrastructure, with the scope to lead technical transformation, develop a high-performing engineering team, and apply cutting-edge AI capabilities to real-world financial systems. This role offers the strategic visibility and technical depth that senior engineers look for.   Lead the modernisation of a globally significant check payment platform, with direct influence over architecture, strategy, and engineering outcomes.  Work at the intersection of high-throughput financial systems and applied AI, with access to modern tooling, platforms, and engineering talent.  Hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, available across our Irving, TX and Tampa, FL locations.  Build and develop a high-performing engineering team, with the autonomy to shape technical culture, standards, and capability growth.  Build and develop a high-performing engineering team, with the autonomy to shape technical culture, standards, and capability growth.  Competitive financial wellbeing support and a comprehensive benefits package aligned to seniority and location  Senior visibility and business impact as part of Citi's broader payments modernisation programme, with exposure to cross-functional leadership across Technology, Risk, Finance, and Operations.  Access to learning and development resources that support continued technical growth and leadership progression at scale.  Competitive financial wellbeing support and a comprehensive benefits package aligned to seniority and location.     Apply now to take on a senior engineering leadership role at Citi and help shape the future of global payments infrastructure.    #LI-MB1                         ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family Group:   Technology              ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family:  Applications Development            ------------------------------------------------------              Time Type:  Full time            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location:  Tampa Florida United States            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location Full Time Salary Range:  $141,440.00 - $212,160.00  In addition to salary, Citi’s offerings may also include, for eligible employees, discretionary and formulaic incentive and retention awards. title: MuleSoft Technical Architect - Public Sector
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Customer Success    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.         Please note:   Qualification for this job is contingent upon acceptable results from a background investigation as well as your obtaining and maintaining the specific level of U.S. Government security clearance that may be required for this role. U.S. citizenship (U.S. born or naturalized) required     About MuleSoft, a Salesforce Company   Our mission is to help organizations change and innovate faster by making it easy to connect the world’s applications, data, and devices. Companies like Spotify, McDonald’s, and Unilever rely on MuleSoft to stay agile, deliver faster, and make the most of their IT investment with API-led connectivity.   Hiring exceptional people who want to build a great company together is our number one priority, and we’re committed to providing an equal opportunity workplace where everyone is supported and inspired to do their best work. We work tirelessly to build this culture, and we’re proud to have been named the #1 Top Workplace in the Bay Area and a best place to work 6 years in a row.   Role Overview   As a Technical Architect on our Public Sector Services team, you will realize solutions for our customers by working hands-on with our federal, state, and local government customers and partners to solve critically important business challenges using MuleSoft’s Anypoint Platform. You provide technical and strategic guidance to MuleSoft implementation projects, evaluate the customer’s technical and functional requirements, and develop efficient solutions to help customers achieve their business transformation goals. Within MuleSoft, you are a thought leader whose voice and actions are essential in growing our overall Services business, team, and culture.    As a Technical Architect, you get to:   Be fearless    Apply your passion for learning to achieve both personal and professional growth by quickly picking up new skills through MuleSoft and Salesforce product and services training and by completing MuleSoft technical certifications.  Jump right in and provide immediate impact in your first three months by shadowing Senior Architects and participating in field activities using skills gained during your onboarding.  Use your autonomy as an implementation leader to act and take risks in order to accelerate your growth while providing innovative and unique solutions to complex business problems.    Make it awesome    Work closely with customers and MuleSoft team members to architect transformational technology solutions to meet client business needs in accordance with industry best practices.  Lead customer, partner, and MuleSoft technical teams through multi-phased delivery projects and provide hands-on delivery guidance to influence standards for development, governance, and the operational life cycle.  Guide product direction and features by providing valuable insight to MuleSoft product leadership.    Own it    Identify risks and blockers throughout engagements and contribute to designing and implementing internal mitigation measures to meet customer needs.  Find opportunities to expand the MuleSoft footprint through professional services sales and to expand cross-collaboration with MuleSoft partners, system integrators, and third-parties.    Be a good human    Train, coach, and mentor Services team members in technical and consulting skills.  Use your high EQ to bring both empathy and accountability to the team.  Participate in Salesforce-sponsored volunteer activities to make your community and world a better place.      To be successful, you have:    Must reside in the Washington, DC metro area.  Six to ten years of proven track record leading integration teams and architecting solutions within a diverse technical team of clients, system integrators, contractors, and internal teams.  Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.).  Experience conducting technical workshops with technical and business clients to drive effective services and implementations.  Proven experiences architecting services integrations with at least two of the following:  MuleSoft or other solutions (e.g., IBM, BEA, Oracle Fusion, TIBCO, Dell Boomi, Progress Sonic, etc.)  API Management solutions (Apigee, Mashery, etc)  One or more on-premise or SaaS packaged COTS (Commercial Off-the-Shelf) solution for ERP, CRM, e-Commerce, or mobile (e.g. Salesforce.com, NetSuite, Oracle, Siebel, SAP, Workday, etc.)    Solid understanding of on-premise and cloud-based infrastructures, SDLC pipelines, configuration, and deployment.  Experience with API and integration security with solid grasp of authentication and authorization concepts and principles.  Demonstrated experience with high-availability, fault-tolerance, performance testing and tuning parameters on multiple engagements.  Ability to work independently and be a self-starter.  Ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies.  Desire for continuous study of new technologies and functionality, and involvement in projects that push the capabilities of existing technologies.  Travel may be required up to 25% and varies depending on the client requirements.      NOTE: By applying to the MuleSoft Technical Architect posting, recruiters and hiring managers across the organization hiring Technical Architects will review your resume. Our goal is for you to apply once and have your resume reviewed by multiple hiring teams.     BENEFITS & PERKS    Comprehensive benefits package including well-being reimbursement, generous parental leave, adoption assistance, fertility benefits, and more!  World-class enablement and on-demand training with   Trailhead.com    Exposure to executive thought leaders and regular 1:1 coaching with leadership  Volunteer opportunities and participation in our 1:1:1 model for giving back to the community  For more details, visit   https://www.salesforcebenefits.com/      ​       In school, or graduated within the past 12 months? Please visit     FutureForce       for opportunities.        This candidate must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) who does not hold dual citizenship and agrees to complete a U.S. federal government Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) for a Moderate Public Trust position.      Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
